loose.note: Sticks and small stones lying about on the farm, picked up with a tap (feature visible-work, ticket 03). start = how many of each lie there in a new game; every = one new thing every so many steps of time; max = the most lying about at once (after the start; the start may be more); kinds = chosen in turn. Where one lies is rolled as a share u, v of the farm's area and saved; the map finds the free spot nearest to it. Picking one up is the chore pick_loose (rules/46-chores.json).
